turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on always, usually, sometimes and never?
turns.tutor:
Rule: put always, usually, sometimes or never before the action word, but after am, is or are.
Right: "Owls usually hunt at night." Wrong: "Owls hunt usually at night." In the wrong one, usually comes after the action word hunt.
My example: "The zoo is always busy." I think: there is no action word here, only is, so always goes after is.
Now you try. Put the words in order:
"usually / my cousin / walks / to school"
